header.ask.golem.removal.player: {player} must choose who to take a golem from
header.ask.golem.removal.you: Choose the golem to be removed
header.choose.spell.orientation.player: {player} must choose the spell to cast
header.choose.tile.player: {player} must place a tile on the battlefield
header.choose.tile.you.place: Place a tile on the battlefield
header.start.player: {player} must choose to keep his/her hand or to change it
tuto.5.golems.1: On a tile, there may be a maximum of 5 golems
tuto.5.golems.2: If there's more, the attacker removes opponents' golems until reaching a total of 5 golems.
tuto.5.golems.3: If that is not enough, he/she removes some of his/her own golems.
tuto.5.golems.4: You must play a move to get 5 golems on a tile, removing opponent's golems
tuto.5.golems.5: If a tile is controlled by 5 golems, the tile gets an extra magic shield <0/>.
tuto.basics.1: You have 2 tiles in your hand and a stack of golems.
tuto.basics.2: In turn, tiles are placed in the central area called the battlefield.
tuto.basics.3: Placing tiles will result in placing golems in the battlefield.
tuto.basics.4: This point will be discussed shortly.
tuto.basics.5: A player controls a tile if he/she has more golems on it than any other opponent.
tuto.basics.6: At the end of the game, a controlled tile gives the amount of victory points written in its lower right corner.
tuto.basics.7: For instance, the central tile - called Well of Mana - gives 3 victory points.
tuto.basics.8: The player with the higher number of victory points wins.
tuto.broken.shield.1: During an attack 3 tiles away, golems gain the property 'broken shield' <0/> and are not impacted by shields.
tuto.broken.shield.3: 1 golem was placed on the opponent tile.
tuto.end.turn.1: After placing the tile, your hand is completed with a new tile.
tuto.game.over.2: all players played all their tiles
tuto.game.over.4: one of the players placed his/her last golem onto the battlefield
tuto.goal.1: Rivality lets you step in the boots of a powerful wizard, fighting against merciless rivals for the control of the coveted Well of Mana. Prepare to summon mighty armies of Golems, build massive and impregnable fortresses, and take the upper hand over your opponents in this epic battle!
tuto.goal.2: Your goal is to score the most victory points by controlling tiles.
tuto.good.luck.1: Now it's up to you to continue this game.
tuto.over:
Congratulations, you've completed the tutorial!
Ready to play with other players?
tuto.round.1: Your opponent chose to summon 2 golems on the Well of Mana, in order to control it.
tuto.round.3: You must turn your tiles to the top
tuto.round.4: You must place the tile at the highlighted location, turned towards the top side
tuto.round.4b: You may turn a tile before validating the move.
tuto.round.5: You must turn your tiles to the bottom
tuto.round.6: You must place the tile at the highlighted location, turned towards the bottom side
tuto.round.7: You must turn your tiles to the left
tuto.score.1: Each player earns the number of victory points for the tiles he/she controls, except those with a wizard on them.
tuto.score.2: In case of equality for the control of a tile, if a tied player controls the Well of Mana, he/she earns the victory points of the tile.
tuto.score.3: In case of equality, the player controlling the Well of Mana wins ... even if he/she was last on score.
tuto.score.4: Example: Players 1 and 2 have 23 points. Player 3 has 19 points and controls the Well of Mana. Player 3 wins.
tuto.shield.2: In case of an attack of a tile controlled by an opponent, the attacker loses a number of golems equal to the number of shields.
tuto.shield.3: You've just attacked a tile protected by a shield.
tuto.shield.4: Due to this shield, you only placed 2 golems on the tile instead of 3.
tuto.spells.1: There are symbols on the sides of the tile indicating summoning spells.
tuto.spells.2: On the left, 3 golems are summoned 2 tiles away.
tuto.spells.3: At the top, 1 golem is summoned 1 tile away.
tuto.spells.5: As there's no tile at the left, the corresponding spell is lost.
tuto.spells.6: At the top of the tile, there's the Well of Mana on which 1 golem was summoned.
tuto.tiles.1: How do we place tiles and golems?
tuto.tiles.2: In turn, players choose one of their tiles and place it next to another tile on the battlefield.
tuto.tiles.3: After placing a tile, you may cancel the move, rotate the tile or validate the move.
tuto.tiles.4c: We are going to explain everything straight away.
tuto.tiles.4d: Place your first tile below the Well of Mana without turning it, then validate
tuto.turn.tile.3: You must place a tile at the left of the opponent's tile,
tuto.turn.tile.4: turn it towards the right side in order to summon 2 golems on the Well of Mana,
tuto.wizard.1: Your wizard and one of your golems were placed onto the tile.
tuto.wizard.2: The wizard protects the tile from opponents' attacks.
